programs.title: The Way Back
programs.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, THE WAY BACK begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberan gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 4,500-mile trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. Their humanity is further tested when they meet a teenage runway who begs to join them on their quest.

programs.title: Moulin Rouge
programs.desc: A young Englishman in the Paris of 1899, becomes infatuated with Satine, a singer at the Moulin Rouge. However, she has been promised by the manager to a Duke in return for funding his next production. As the young lovers meet in secret, Satine's wedding day draws closer but she hides a fatal secret from both Christian and the Duke.

programs.title: Side Effects
programs.desc: Jon Banks is a young, ambitious psychiatrist who wants to show what he's capable of. Since there are no known medications that can help depressed patient Emily, Joe prescribes a new experimental medication. Emily becomes happy again, full of energy and passionately in love with her husband Martin. But one evening, Martin is stabbed to death. At the crime scene, you find Emily, who doesn't remember anything at all. Is it because of the medication? Can Joe Banks uncover the truth?

programs.title: Danny Collins
programs.desc: Al Pacino stars as aging 1970s rocker Danny Collins, who can’t give up his hard-living ways. But when his manager (Christopher Plummer) uncovers a 40-year-old undelivered letter written to him by John Lennon, he decides to change course and embarks on a heartfelt journey to rediscover his family, find true love and begin a second act.
